anomalies.description: A sudden, bright flash and rapid expansion of white smoke at the center of the crowd, consistent with a small explosive device (e.g., smoke or stun grenade) detonating on the street surface.

A large group of people engaged in violent unrest, with multiple individuals throwing objects and a cloud of smoke (likely from a canister or explosion) rapidly expanding in the center of the street, causing crowd dispersal and chaotic movement. Flags are visible amid the confrontation.

Large crowd engaged in violent group clashes on a city street, with smoke (likely from tear gas or smoke grenades) present and multiple individuals actively confronting each other; flags (including US and Polish) are visible among opposing groups.

Direct physical combat between individuals is visible: in frames f10–f15, people are seen striking, grappling, and using objects (e.g., a wooden plank in f14) against others in close proximity; helmets and protective gear suggest anticipation of violence.
Multiple individuals engage in mutual physical combat using fists, sticks, and shields; participants are seen striking, grappling, and blocking across the entire sequence.

Large group of people engaged in violent, chaotic clashes on a city street, with smoke visible, flags being waved amid combat, and coordinated aggressive movements indicating collective violent unrest.

A group of heavily armed police officers in riot gear are deployed on the back of a moving pickup truck, driving through an urban street with onlookers and protesters present; the scene shows coordinated tactical movement consistent with crowd control during civil unrest.

At the intersection, a person in red pants appears to be struck or pushed by a police officer standing near the truck bed as the vehicle moves forward; the individual stumbles backward onto the crosswalk while officers remain on the truck platform.

Initial frames show apparent physical struggle involving the person on the ground and at least one other individual; movements suggest active resistance or engagement before restraint is fully established.

A person is lying on the ground while being restrained by multiple individuals, including a police officer and others in tactical gear; the restrained individual appears helpless and is not actively resisting, suggesting abuse rather than mutual combat.
